After generation, Watch shows a timed tr: After generation, Watch shows a timed transcript beside the video. The current line is highlighted as the video plays.
Build the extension with your backend ad: Build the extension with your backend address as described in the source repository. Settings shows the configured address. Use localhost for your computer or HTTPS for a private server.
Cancellation stops remaining work where: Cancellation stops remaining work where possible. Provider requests already sent can still finish and incur provider charges.
Check Study → Show overlay, play a part: Check Study → Show overlay, play a part of the video with speech, and confirm the selected saved generation. Use Refresh saved generations if needed.
Check that the extension is enabled. Ope: Check that the extension is enabled. Open Chrome’s :slot1:Extensions:slot2: menu and pin it to your toolbar.
Check your backend connection and provid: Check your backend connection and provider keys in Settings. Make sure the backend workers are running.
Choose an available OpenAI or Cerebras m: Choose an available OpenAI or Cerebras model for this video.
Choose how long to keep saved tracks. Le: Choose how long to keep saved tracks. Leave retention blank to keep them until you delete them. A number applies to existing and future tracks from their original generation date.
Chrome Extensions toolbar with Developer: Chrome Extensions toolbar with Developer mode on and the Load unpacked button visible.
Clear local state resets browser setting: Clear local state resets browser settings and remembered tracks. It does not delete saved generations or provider keys from your instance.
Click the word to pin its detail card. N: Click the word to pin its detail card. New details may take a moment to load the first time you request them.
Delete saved generations from the extens: Delete saved generations from the extension’s History view. If a deleted track is still visible on an open YouTube page, refresh the page.
Download the extension ZIP provided to y: Download the extension ZIP provided to you and extract it into a folder you will keep on your computer.
Editing and interactive word cards becom: Editing and interactive word cards become available once the track is complete. Every generation uses the same worker pipeline.
Enable :slot1:Pause video on word hover:: Enable :slot1:Pause video on word hover:slot2: to pause while inspecting a word. These are display preferences; they do not start another generation.
Enable :slot1:Study → Keyboard shortcuts: Enable :slot1:Study → Keyboard shortcuts → Shortcuts enabled:slot2:. Use these while the YouTube page has focus. Shortcuts do not run while you are typing in an input or editing text. On Mac, Alt is the Option key.
Enter the replacement in :slot1:Correct: Enter the replacement in :slot1:Correct word:slot2: and choose :slot3:Save correction:slot4:. Use :slot5:Cancel:slot6: to discard an unsaved edit.
Everyone who can reach your instance sha: Everyone who can reach your instance shares its provider keys and saved generations. Keep it on your computer or a trusted private network.
Find the line in :slot1:Watch:slot2:, us: Find the line in :slot1:Watch:slot2:, using transcript search if needed.
Follow the named progress stages. Subtit: Follow the named progress stages. Subtitles appear on the video as they become ready. You can close the side panel while generation continues.
Follow the source repository’s setup ins: Follow the source repository’s setup instructions to start the backend, database, Redis and subtitle workers on your computer or private server.
For a failed job, open the video, review: For a failed job, open the video, review Watch settings, and choose Generate. The failed job’s options are not automatically restored.
For a manual update, extract the new pac: For a manual update, extract the new package into that same folder, then select the extension’s reload button on :slot1:. Refresh your open YouTube pages afterward.
For a small mistake, edit one word in a: For a small mistake, edit one word in a completed transcript instead of replacing the full lyrics.
From your first install to your next fav: From your first install to your next favorite song. Find the steps for every tool in the extension.
Full lyrics correction uses the generati: Full lyrics correction uses the generation’s saved model. Incomplete or wrong lyrics can put words at the wrong times. Generate again to start from the audio.
Generated AI subtitles and language-lear: Generated AI subtitles and language-learning word cards for public YouTube videos.
If the subtitles appear too early or lat: If the subtitles appear too early or late, adjust :slot1:Timing:slot2: with the slider or seconds field. The range is −10 to +10 seconds in 0.1-second steps. Use :slot3:Reset:slot4: to return to zero. This changes playback display timing, not the words or the stored cue timings.
In :slot1:Study → Active recall:slot2:,: In :slot1:Study → Active recall:slot2:, enable :slot3:Pause video on word hover:slot4: if you want time to read. Word cards explain the current video’s words; saved vocabulary and spaced-repetition review are not currently available.
In :slot1:Watch:slot2:, select the track: In :slot1:Watch:slot2:, select the track in :slot3:Saved generation:slot4:, then choose :slot5:Lyric correction:slot6:.
Include the job ID, error code and steps: Include the job ID, error code and steps to reproduce when reporting an issue. Do not share provider keys or private transcripts.
Keep the text within the displayed 25,00: Keep the text within the displayed 25,000-character limit. Choose :slot1:Continue:slot2: and review the full-track replacement notice.
Open :slot1:Study → Caption display:slot: Open :slot1:Study → Caption display:slot2:. Use :slot3:Show overlay:slot4: to show or hide the subtitles on the video. Choose :slot5:Bottom:slot6:, :slot7:Top:slot8:, or :slot9:Compact:slot10: under Position, then adjust :slot11:Caption size:slot12:, :slot13:Density:slot14:, and :slot15:Contrast:slot16:. :slot17:Word gloss:slot18: controls available short word meanings.
Open Chrome’s :slot1:Extensions:slot2: m: Open Chrome’s :slot1:Extensions:slot2: menu (the puzzle icon) and pin the extension so it stays in your toolbar.
Open Settings, check the backend address: Open Settings, check the backend address, and save your provider keys. Follow the instance setup steps below.
Open a public YouTube video or Short and: Open a public YouTube video or Short and select the extension’s toolbar icon. Its side panel opens beside the page.
Open the extension’s Chrome Web Store li: Open the extension’s Chrome Web Store listing in Chrome.
Open your video and the extension’s :slo: Open your video and the extension’s :slot1:Watch:slot2: tab. Check that the video at the top of the panel is the one you want.
Open-source YouTube subtitles and langua: Open-source YouTube subtitles and language study. Run your own instance and bring your own API keys.
Paste the complete lyrics for this exact: Paste the complete lyrics for this exact version of the song, in order. Include every repeated verse and chorus. Remove section tags such as :slot1:, :slot2:, and :slot3:; paste only the words that are sung.
Play a completed track and move over a w: Play a completed track and move over a word in the subtitles on the video to preview the available word information.
Provider keys are encrypted on your inst: Provider keys are encrypted on your instance. The extension clears key inputs after saving. A blank key field keeps the existing key; use Clear to remove one.
Read the meaning, pronunciation, and usa: Read the meaning, pronunciation, and usage information available for that word in its sentence. Click another word to explore it.
Return to Watch, choose your languages a: Return to Watch, choose your languages and model, then generate subtitles.
Save an ElevenLabs key for transcription: Save an ElevenLabs key for transcription and an OpenAI or Cerebras key for analysis.
Saved generations stay on your instance: Saved generations stay on your instance until you delete them or their configured retention period expires.
Select :slot1:Add to Chrome:slot2:, revi: Select :slot1:Add to Chrome:slot2:, review the permissions, and confirm with :slot3:Add extension:slot4:.
Select :slot1:Change:slot2: beside the l: Select :slot1:Change:slot2: beside the language pair. Choose the :slot3:Video language:slot4:, or use :slot5:Auto detect:slot6: when you are unsure. Choose your :slot7:Translation language:slot8: separately.
Select :slot1:Copy:slot2: to copy the li: Select :slot1:Copy:slot2: to copy the line’s text.
Select :slot1:Edit:slot2: on that line,: Select :slot1:Edit:slot2: on that line, then select the word you want to correct.
Select :slot1:Jump:slot2: on a line to s: Select :slot1:Jump:slot2: on a line to seek the video to that point.
Select :slot1:Load unpacked:slot2: and c: Select :slot1:Load unpacked:slot2: and choose the extracted folder containing :slot3:. Choose the folder, not the ZIP file.
Select :slot1:Replace entire track:slot2: Select :slot1:Replace entire track:slot2: to confirm. The compact status strip shows progress; choose :slot3:View progress:slot4: for the stages or :slot5:Cancel replacement:slot6: while it is running.
Select Generate subtitles to start. Prov: Select Generate subtitles to start. Provider requests use your own keys.
Select Load unpacked, then choose the ex: Select Load unpacked, then choose the extracted folder containing manifest.json.
Switch to a public YouTube video or Shor: Switch to a public YouTube video or Short in the same window. After installing or updating, refresh the page and reopen the panel.
The :slot1:History:slot2: tab lists your: The :slot1:History:slot2: tab lists your latest 25 jobs, grouped into Videos and Shorts. Use :slot3:Open video:slot4: to return to YouTube. Available completed generations are recovered for that video.
The Chrome Web Store link is not availab: The Chrome Web Store link is not available here yet. If you have been given an extension ZIP, use the manual steps below.
The correction keeps the line’s timing a: The correction keeps the line’s timing and refreshes its translation, enabled pronunciation readings, and word cards. Wait for generation or a lyrics replacement to finish before making another correction.
The extension screenshots below use an e: The extension screenshots below use an example song and sample lyrics. Select an image to view it at full size.
To move subtitles freely, uncheck :slot1: To move subtitles freely, uncheck :slot1:Attach subtitles to video:slot2: and drag the :slot3:Move subtitles:slot4: handle. You can also focus the handle and use the arrow keys; hold Shift for larger steps. Check attachment again to return to the selected position. The free position lasts while the overlay is open.
To try different languages, layers, or a: To try different languages, layers, or a model on a video with a completed track, choose :slot1:Generate again:slot2: above the transcript. Changing next-generation settings does not change an existing saved track.
Translations and pronunciation readings: Translations and pronunciation readings depend on the layers available in that generation. Choosing the same video and translation language does not produce a second-language translation.
Turn on :slot1:Developer mode:slot2: in: Turn on :slot1:Developer mode:slot2: in the upper-right corner.
Turn on Developer mode. Chrome then show: Turn on Developer mode. Chrome then shows the manual installation buttons.

Hover or focus the part you want to reveal when you need a hint. Source-word reveals include that word’s reading when available; the full reading and translation can be revealed separately.

Use :slot1:Generate again:slot2: or :slo: Use :slot1:Generate again:slot2: or :slot3:Lyric correction:slot4: above search to open those tools. :slot5:Back to transcript:slot6: returns to the reading view.

Use :slot1:Search transcript:slot2: to f: Use :slot1:Search transcript:slot2: to find a line.
Use desktop Chrome. The extension works: Use desktop Chrome. The extension works with public YouTube videos and Shorts; existing captions are not required.
Use this when you have the complete lyri: Use this when you have the complete lyrics for a song and want to replace its generated transcript. Start with a completed generation.
Wait for the update, then check the line: Wait for the update, then check the line. Select :slot1:Done:slot2: to leave word selection.
When replacement finishes, play several: When replacement finishes, play several lines to check the wording and timing. Translations, enabled pronunciation readings, and word data are rebuilt with the corrected text.
Yes. Choose Edit on a transcript line, s: Yes. Choose Edit on a transcript line, select a word, and enter the correction. The app refreshes that line’s learning data while keeping its timing. Your configured provider handles the request.
